Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-transcribe-medium-0172", "row_sha256": "07248163019cc4572a8d5af333b2136d39427c5c746f4510b32496b3e923546f", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "for the screen reader audit at the north desk i checked the purchase summary with keyboard navigation and listened to each field through the laptop speaker the item was a replacement audio cable for the shared test station and the order page showed the quantity as one the price field was announced after the item name but before the shipping line which made it easy to miss when moving quickly i repeated the route with the screen reader set to the slower rate and wrote down the amount that was actually charged the cost was $46.71 not $161.98 the larger number appeared in the estimated annual spend panel and was not the price of the cable i also checked the emailed receipt and its total matched the order page no tax was listed as a separate line on that receipt so i did not add another amount to my notes i saved the browser name and the screen reader settings in the audit log the volume was low at first because the laptop was connected to the meeting room display after i changed the output setting the spoken labels were clear i left the product name and both amounts in the note and asked the team to check the order page with the same keyboard route before the next audit session", "output": "For the screen reader audit at the north desk, I checked the purchase summary with keyboard navigation and listened to each field through the laptop speaker. The item was a replacement audio cable for the shared test station, and the order page showed the quantity as one. The price field was announced after the item name but before the shipping line, which made it easy to miss when moving quickly. I repeated the route with the screen reader set to the slower rate and wrote down the amount that was actually charged. The cost was $46.71, not $161.98. The larger number appeared in the estimated annual spend panel and was not the price of the cable. I also checked the emailed receipt, and its total matched the order page. No tax was listed as a separate line on that receipt, so I did not add another amount to my notes. I saved the browser name and the screen reader settings in the audit log. The volume was low at first because the laptop was connected to the meeting room display. After I changed the output setting, the spoken labels were clear. I left the product name and both amounts in the note and asked the team to check the order page with the same keyboard route before the next audit session."}]
